nodes.name: defaults.yaml
nodes.summary: Centralized single-source-of-truth defaults for the DutchBay model (CESSPIT compliance), pinning the fallback USD/LKR FX reference (333.79, 2026-Q2 vintage) and the anchored CAPEX/OPEX cost-basis year so no parameter defaults live in Python code. Scenario configs import and override these values.

nodes.name: monte_carlo_regression_production.yaml
nodes.summary: Production-scale Monte Carlo configuration (~3000 LHS iterations, seed 42) defining realistic distributions across CAPEX, capacity factor, OPEX and other parameters plus base/upside scenarios and correlations for lender-grade risk assessment. Counterpart to the fast toy config.

nodes.name: monte_carlo_regression_toy.yaml
nodes.summary: Fast Monte Carlo regression configuration (20 LHS iterations, ~30s) mirroring lender base-case assumptions for rapid dev/CI feedback loops. Reduced-scale counterpart to the production Monte Carlo config.

nodes.name: sensitivity_defaults.yaml
nodes.summary: Default parameter ranges for tornado sensitivity analysis, supplying base values (CAPEX/kW, tariff, capacity factor, discount/debt rates, OPEX) and per-parameter low/high shock percentages validated by the Pydantic ParameterRangeConfig model. Follows CFA/DFI standards for renewable projects.

nodes.name: sensitivity_parameters.yaml
nodes.summary: Lender-case baseline tornado parameter list for the v14 pipeline, defining one-way plus/minus shocks (CAPEX, capacity factor, OPEX and more) around base values with variable_name paths matching the v14 scenario schema. CASPER-ready conservative shock set.

nodes.name: wind_dutchbay_150mw.yaml
nodes.summary: Hydra scenario configuration for the DutchBay 149.5 MW wind farm (23 x Envision EN-171/6.5), specifying project, turbine, Weibull wind resource, loss stack, layout, financial, Monte Carlo and pipeline settings plus expected AEP/revenue validation targets for the full wind-to-finance pipeline.
